slots.node02.text: A close that runs on rules, not reminders
slots.node03.text: Close takes 12 days because work waits for people, not because it is hard. We redesign the sequence so entries are checked as they post and exceptions reach an owner on day one.
slots.node04.body.item01.p: One template and one owner for every balance-sheet account, closed during the month.
slots.node07.body.item01.p: Intercompany balances match overnight, so eleven entities stop trading spreadsheets.
slots.node10.body.item01.p: Controllers review entries as they post, not in a single push on day nine.
slots.node13.body.item01.p: Each close task has an owner, a due time and a clear escalation path.
slots.title: Four design choices shape the new close
